title: LinkedIn Profile Search
description: Search LinkedIn profiles by keywords, job title, location, or skills and save them as leads with full profile details and emails when available. The foundational LinkedIn strategy — best for B2B prospecting when looking for individuals by role or expertise. Use when you need to find decision-makers, hiring managers, or professionals matching specific criteria. For company-focused searches, use the LinkedIn Company Search strategys instead.
tips:
- NEVER use OR operators in searchQuery for job titles (e.g., "CFO OR CTO OR VP" is WRONG). Instead, put all target titles in the currentJobTitles array.
- searchQuery should be a single broad role keyword or left empty when using currentJobTitles.
- currentJobTitles is the MOST EFFECTIVE filter — always use it with an array of ICP decision-maker titles.
- locations should use full, official names.
- Use seniorityLevelIds to target decision-makers (e.g., "220" for Director+, "300" for VP, "310" for CXO).
- MULTIPLE SEARCHES: When 6+ distinct job titles across different seniority levels, generate MULTIPLE search inputs in a "searches" array. Split by seniority tier or function.
- For simple ICPs (1-5 titles), return a single flat JSON object without the "searches" wrapper.
